columns.name: run_id
columns.rule: UUID v4, lower case canonical form, unique in the file

columns.name: git_sha
columns.rule: -dirty if the working tree had uncommitted changes

columns.name: strategy_family
columns.rule: the unit for N, V and PBO

columns.name: params_json
columns.rule: json.dumps(params, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False); a JSON object

columns.name: start
columns.rule: first date in the Parquet; may be empty when n_obs = 0

columns.name: end
columns.rule: last date in the Parquet; start <= end; may be empty when n_obs = 0

columns.name: n_obs
columns.rule: >= 0; equals the Parquet row count; 0 for failed and manual trials

columns.name: sharpe_annual
columns.rule: at least 6 significant digits; mean(ret)/std(ret, ddof=1)*sqrt(q); empty for failed trials

columns.name: returns_path
columns.rule: runs/<run_id>/returns.parquet, relative to the CSV; empty when n_obs = 0

columns.name: x_periods_per_year
columns.rule: positive integer, one value per strategy_family; overrides q inferred from dates

columns.date: date32 (timestamp accepted if every value is midnight)
